items.difficulty_reason: Construct the competitor map: pull the etale cover W -> Z back along each f_i to U_i -> X_i (separated, etale, object of the limit etale category), realize it as U = X x_X' U by hypothesis (5), get h : U -> W by hypothesis (4); then prove the descent: (h,h) : U x_X U -> W x_S W factors through W x_Z W because after composing with U_i x_{X_i} U_i -> U x_X U it does and U x_X U is the colimit of the pairwise products by (4); the two compositions U x_X U -> Z agree, U -> X is surjective by (2), and Z is an etale sheaf, so g descends to f : X -> Z. Opens with a style aside pointing at lemma-colimit-check-etale-locally (not a disclaimer).
